title: MLEADERSTYLE direct-writer leader-type domain

scope.operation: Reject invalid direct-writer MLEADERSTYLE enum values before emitting the record.
scope.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.87 maps group 173 to Leader type; Autodesk ObjectARX Managed Reference documents AcDbMLeaderStyle::LeaderType as InVisibleLeader, StraightLeader, SplineLeader in enum order.
scope.claim_boundary: Direct DXF writer-domain validation and emitted group 173 only; no native MLEADER annotation/rendering or whole-document support claim.

implementation: Validate leaderType <= 2 alongside the existing pre-emission checks for groups 171, 172 and 177.
Preserve all three documented values and existing field serialization.

evidence.input: Runtime-generated typed MLEADERSTYLE objects; no fixture files committed.
evidence.refusal: Each selected invalid enum value refuses before publication; destination sentinel and caller model value remain unchanged.
evidence.retry: The same dx_iface retries after correcting the field to a valid value; the AC1027 output contains exact group 173/value.
evidence.matrix: Four independently mutated writer-domain fields (171, 172, 173, 177) × two invalid values per domain × two encodings; 16 destination-safe refusals and 16 successful retries.

remaining: Other MLEADERSTYLE integer, source-presence, repeated-field, version, dependency and native-rendering profiles remain open.
